sharing.title: Share recipe
sharing.access_hint: Anyone with the link can view this recipe and save their own copy. You can revoke access at any time.
sharing.expiry_hint: Leave empty for a link without an expiry date. The time uses your local time zone.
sharing.invalid_expiry: Choose an expiry date in the future.
sharing.empty: This recipe has no sharing links yet.

sharing.save_hint: You will get your own copy that you can edit.
sharing.unavailable: This link is invalid, expired, or has been revoked.
timers.title: Timers
timers.notifications_denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Timers remain visible here.
timers.notifications_unavailable: Notifications are unavailable. Keep yumi open for alerts.
timers.storage_unavailable: Timers cannot be saved in this browser.
timers.audio_unavailable: Sound is unavailable. Start or resume a timer to enable it.
timers.vibration_unavailable: Vibration is unavailable on this device.
cooking.title: Cooking
cooking.offline_unloaded: You are offline. Reconnect to load this recipe.
cooking.no_ingredients: No ingredients assigned to this step. You can change this in the recipe editor.
cooking.offline: You are offline. Loaded steps remain available; reconnect to record cooking.
ingredients.review_hint: Enter the details yourself or request a suggestion. The ingredient is only saved for your household when you confirm.
ingredients.ai_draft: Review and edit the AI suggestion before saving.
ingredients.manual_draft: An AI suggestion is unavailable. Enter the details yourself.
ingredients.synonyms_hint: Separate alternative names with commas. Up to 20 names of 100 characters each.
app_description: Recipes, meal planning, and shopping for your household.
plan_empty_description: Plan what comes next – no fixed day needed, just in order.
queue.add_hint: Choose servings for your household. You can leave the date open.
queue.added: Recipe added to your meal plan.
queue.order_hint: Use the arrows to reorder; dragging the number works too.
queue.cooked_saved: Marked as cooked and removed from your plan.
queue.skipped_saved: Meal skipped and removed from your plan.
queue.select_hint: Select the meals you want to shop for below.
queue.staples_hint: These ingredients are marked as pantry staples and will be left off the shopping list.
queue.include_staples: Include these pantry staples as well
queue.preview_stale: The meals, ingredients or pantry have changed. Refresh the preview before confirming again.
queue.remove_hint: Shopping items are kept unless you choose the option below. Manual items and contributions from other meals are always kept.
queue.remove_items: Also remove shopping items linked to this planned meal
leftovers.title: Expected leftovers
leftovers.hint: What remains from purchased packs after your planned meals. Adjust the amounts if you use them elsewhere.
leftovers.empty: No expected leftovers yet. They appear when you confirm shopping for your meal plan.
leftovers.invalid_quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero and no more than 1,000,000.
leftovers.no_suggestions: No matching recipes yet. Suggestions use your leftovers or, if selected, ingredients from your meal plan.
list_empty_description: Ingredients for your planned meals will have a place here. Your meal plan is the starting point.
shopping.no_lists_hint: Create a list to start shopping together.
shopping.empty_hint: Add an item above or add ingredients from a recipe.
shopping.catalog_linked: Linked to the ingredient catalog. Changing the name removes the link.
shopping.no_catalog_results: No matching ingredients. You can add your own item by name.
shopping.invalid_quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero and no more than 1,000,000, or leave it empty.
shopping.edit_entries: Edit the {count} individual entries. Quantities and recipe sources are kept separately.
shopping.recipe_needs_list: Create a shopping list first, then add this recipe.
shopping.recipe_added: {count} ingredients added to your shopping list.
shopping.sync_rejected: Some changes could not be saved. The list may have been deleted or the entries are no longer valid.
shopping.local_storage_error: Changes could not be saved on this device. Check that your browser allows local storage and try again.
settings_saved: Changes are saved on this device automatically.
pwa_update_available: A new version of yumi is available.
pwa_install_description: Keep recipes, your meal plan, and your list within reach.
pwa_install_manual: Use your browser menu to install. On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
pwa_installed: yumi is installed on this device.
pwa_install_error: Installation could not be started. Try your browser menu.
pwa_offline: You're offline. Previously saved pages are still available.

auth.sign_in_description: Sign in to plan meals and shop together.

auth.error_user_exists: An account with this email already exists.

auth.error_invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.

onboarding.description: Recipes, plans and shopping lists belong to a household. You can invite others later.

household.leave_confirm: Do you really want to leave this household?
household.error_last_owner: You are the only owner. Remove the other members or delete the household instead.
recipes.empty_description: Type up a favourite, paste an ingredient list or import one from a website. It takes less than two minutes.
recipes.no_results_description: No recipe matches your search, tag and selection. Search looks at titles.
recipes.suggestions_neglected_hint: Never cooked first, then recipes your household has not cooked for the longest time.
recipes.suggestions_favorites_hint: Your ratings of at least 4 out of 5 stars, highest first.
recipes.suggestions_quick_hint: Known prep and cooking times total at most 30 minutes, shortest first.
recipes.delete_confirm: Do you really want to delete "{title}"?
recipes.title: Title
recipes.tags_hint: Press Enter or comma to add a tag.
recipes.image_hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB.
recipes.paste_hint: One ingredient per line, e.g. "200 g flour".
recipes.ingredient_exclude_nutrition_hin: For example salt, pepper or seasoning to taste.
errors.invalid_ingredient: One of the linked ingredients no longer exists. Please check the list.
errors.invalid_image: This file is not a supported image. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
errors.image_too_large: The image is too large. The maximum is 10 MB.
stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Each store can sort the categories of your list in the order you walk through it.
stores.name: Store name
stores.empty_hint: Add the stores you shop at to sort your list by their aisles.
stores.category_order_hint: Drag the categories or use the arrows to match the route through the store.
stores.learning_hint: The order learns from your trips to this store. A custom category order takes priority.
stores.learning_reset: Order reset. New shopping trips will teach it again.
stores.delete_confirm: Delete the store "{name}"? Lists using it fall back to the default order.
shopping.quick_hint: Type an amount and an item, then press Enter or pick a suggestion.
pantry.title: Pantry staples
pantry.description: Staples are always at home. They are skipped when you add a recipe to a shopping list, and you can still add them if you run out.
pantry.empty_hint: Add things like salt, oil or pepper that you always have at home.
pantry.check_hint: These staples were not added to the list.
recurring.title: Recurring items
recurring.description: These items go back on this list on their day when the list is opened. If the last one is still open, it is not added twice.
recipes.import_review: Review the imported draft and adjust it if needed. Nothing is saved until you choose “Save recipe”.
recipes.import_image_missing: The page image could not be imported. You can choose one yourself.
recipes.import_photos_hint: Add up to 5 cookbook pages in reading order, as JPEG, PNG or WebP (up to 10 MiB and 24 megapixels each). All pages must belong to one recipe. AI reads the pages; you review the draft before saving. The page photos are not saved.
errors.photo_import_count: Choose between 1 and 5 photos of the same recipe.
errors.photo_import_type: Use JPEG, PNG or WebP photos. Convert other formats first.
errors.photo_import_size: Each photo must be nonempty and no larger than 10 MiB.
errors.photo_import_invalid: A photo could not be read or exceeds 24 megapixels. Choose a smaller, valid image.
errors.photo_import_unavailable: Photo import needs AI enabled with a model that supports images. You can enter the recipe manually.
errors.photo_import_failed: The photos could not be read. Try clearer photos or enter the recipe manually. The configured AI model must support images.
errors.photo_import_no_recipe: No complete recipe was recognized. Include clear photos of the ingredients and instructions for one recipe.
errors.import_no_recipe: No recipe data was found on this page.
errors.import_failed: The page could not be loaded. Check the link or try again later.
errors.import_invalid_url: This link cannot be imported. Use a public http or https address.
recipes.nutrition_source: Reference values from USDA FoodData Central, your own ingredient data and AI estimates. Ingredients without a quantity, gram conversion or nutrition data are left out of the total.
ingredients.nutrition_hint: Fill in all seven values or leave them all empty.
ingredients.nutrition_incomplete: Please fill in all seven nutrition values or leave them all empty.
recipes.import_link_text: Works with most recipe pages that include a recipe card. You review the draft before anything is saved.
recipes.import_share_text: Tap “Share” in the browser or a recipe app and pick yumi. Works once yumi is installed. On iPhone and iPad: copy the link and paste it here.
